Once I started driving on my own, I realized I hadn't been taught how to downshift from 4th or 5th gear or how to accelerate smoothly on a slope without jerking the car. Pros: Decent for basic car control.
Cons: No high-gear training, lacks instruction on downshifting and slope management.

I am writing to share my recent experience with Shubham Driving School to ensure others are fully informed before enrolling. While I chose this school due to its convenient location and positive reviews, my experience with my assigned instructor, Rohit Kumar, has been highly disappointing.

Mr. Rohit demonstrated a significant lack of professionalism throughout our sessions. Furthermore, on my fifth day of training, he inappropriately demanded a bribe (baksheesh), claiming I had already mastered driving despite the fact that he had not yet taught me essential maneuvers like parking.

Based on this experience, I strongly recommend that prospective students thoroughly vet their instructors before committing.
